constitutions.Customers:
# Customers — constitution
**Purpose:** Customer identity and KYC (know your customer).
**Owner:** Compliance · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** A customer's national id and date of birth are [Pii]. Only a compliance officer can verify or reject a customer. A customer who is not Verified cannot open accounts.
**Forbidden:** Personal data in events, logs or messages; customers verifying themselves.
constitutions.Loans:
# Loans — constitution
**Purpose:** Loan applications, credit decisions and payouts.
**Owner:** Credit · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Only loan officers decide on loans; an officer never decides on their own loan (four-eyes rule). Payouts go from LoanFunding through the Ledger.
**Forbidden:** Self-approval; paying out before approval; changing a decided loan.
constitutions.Payments:
# Payments — constitution
**Purpose:** Money transfers between accounts, inside the bank and across currencies.
**Owner:** Payments · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** A customer pays only from an account they own. Each payment carries an idempotency key: the same key never pays twice. The daily limit from BankSettings applies per customer per UTC day, in EUR equivalent. Money moves only through the Ledger.
**Forbidden:** Paying twice for one key; skipping the limit or the fraud hold; trusting an account id without an ownership check.
constitutions.Ledger:
# Ledger — constitution
**Purpose:** The only place money moves: double-entry postings in one currency.
**Owner:** Finance · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Every transfer writes two entries that sum to zero. Customer accounts never go below zero. Amounts are whole cents. Currencies must match: convert first.
**Forbidden:** Editing Account.Balance anywhere else; posting between different currencies; deleting or editing ledger entries.
constitutions.Fees:
# Fees — constitution
**Purpose:** Fees the bank charges.
**Owner:** Finance · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Fees are published (rate, minimum, maximum) and always shown to the customer before they pay. Fees go to the FeeIncome account in the payment's currency.
**Forbidden:** Charging more than the published fee; hiding a fee.
constitutions.Auth:
# Auth — constitution
**Purpose:** Who is calling and what they may do.
**Owner:** Security · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Every endpoint has an [Authorize] policy. Staff roles: teller, loan-officer, compliance-officer, admin. User ids come only from ICurrentUser.
**Forbidden:** AllowAnonymous on any endpoint that touches customer data or money; reading a user id from a request body.
constitutions.Fx:
# Fx — constitution
**Purpose:** Currency exchange rates and conversion.
**Owner:** Treasury · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Rates come from the bank's rate table. Converted amounts are rounded to cents, half away from zero. Cross-currency money moves through the FxClearing accounts of both currencies.
**Forbidden:** Hard-coded rates in other modules; converting without rounding.
constitutions.Cards:
# Cards — constitution
**Purpose:** Debit cards and card payment authorisation.
**Owner:** Cards · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** A card belongs to one account and one customer. A frozen or cancelled card never authorises a payment. Card number is [Pii]; only the last four digits may be shown or sent.
**Forbidden:** Authorising on a frozen card; exposing full card numbers.
constitutions.Deposits:
# Deposits — constitution
**Purpose:** Term deposits that pay interest.
**Owner:** Savings · **Risk:** MEDIUM
**Rules:** Money in a deposit sits in the DepositHolding account. Interest is paid from InterestExpense at maturity, rounded to cents. Breaking a deposit early forfeits all interest.
**Forbidden:** Paying interest before maturity; changing the rate of an open deposit.
constitutions.Statements:
# Statements — constitution
**Purpose:** Account statements for a calendar month.
**Owner:** Customer care · **Risk:** MEDIUM
**Rules:** A statement covers the whole month (from the first day 00:00 UTC up to the first day of the next month). Opening balance + all entries = closing balance. Only the owner (or staff) may read it.
**Forbidden:** Missing or double-counting entries at month edges; statements of other customers' accounts.
constitutions.Audit:
# Audit — constitution
**Purpose:** The compliance trail: every domain event is recorded.
**Owner:** Compliance · **Risk:** HIGH
**Rules:** Events are stored without [Pii] properties. The trail is append-only.
**Forbidden:** Turning auditing off for any event; storing personal data in the trail.
constitutions.Accounts:
# Accounts — constitution
**Purpose:** Customer accounts and ownership.
**Owner:** Core banking · **Risk:** MEDIUM
**Rules:** An account is visible only to its owner (and staff where a module says so). IBAN is personal data ([Pii]). Opening an account asks every IAccountOpeningRule first.
**Forbidden:** Returning IBANs to other users; changing a balance outside the Ledger.
constitutions.Notifications:
# Notifications — constitution
**Purpose:** Messages to customers.
**Owner:** Customer care · **Risk:** LOW
**Rules:** Messages are short and contain no [Pii] values (no IBANs, no national ids).
**Forbidden:** Sending personal data in a message.
